about: Numbers and times of day in every formatting locale, and a pseudo-Czech catalogue in cs-CZ. src/core/format.ts. Generated by tools/fixtures/format.ts (npm run fixtures): do not hand-edit.

catalogue.about: A pseudo-locale for tests: Czech's plural rule and Czech formatting, and no Czech words. Each template says which form it is, so a test can see the form picked and the number written. Never shipped: it lives under test/, not copy/. Keys it lacks fall back to English, as a real translation's would.
